frontmatter.name: sprint-planner
frontmatter.description: Barcha topilgan muammolarni avtomatik ticket-larga ajratib sprint-ga tarqatadi. Regression tracking: avvalgi muammolar tuzatilganmi, yangi narsa singanmi. Bug Sprint (shu hafta kritiklar), Sprint N (muhimlar), Backlog (minor), Feature Roadmap (yangi). Trigger: "ticket yer", "sprint rejalashtr", "backlog", "regression", "BUG-" haqida so'rov.
